verdicts.reason: A keeps the quote as the dominant element and puts the can on the right, which reads well left to right. But the attribution is too small to read, the SOLSTICE logo has shrunk to an unreadable dot and the quote mark is crammed into the top-left corner. B sets the quote in small type pushed toward the top edge. Its yellow 'THE SOLSTICE TASTING TEAM' attribution is as heavy as the quote, which reverses the hierarchy. The can is shrunk to a cropped sliver, the logo is missing and the left block is ragged.
